+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");

+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
+    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
+                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
+    return {offset, quotient + extra};
 }

-void printUsage(const char* progName) {

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+void printUsage(const char* programName) {
+    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);

+    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation against known values\n");
+    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
+    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
 }

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

-void printUsage(const char* progName) {

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
+    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
+                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
+    return {offset, quotient + extra};
 }

-void printUsage(const char* progName) {

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+void printUsage(const char* programName) {
+    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);

+    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation against known values\n");
+    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
+    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
 }

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

    78	Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
    79	                     const int partition) noexcept {
    80	    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
    81	    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
    82	    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
    83	    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
    84	                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
    85	    return {offset, quotient + extra};
    86	}

    91	                 expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    92	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
    93	    std::abort();
    94	}

   104	__device__ __forceinline__ double cumulativeNormalDevice(const double x) {
   105	    // This is deliberately the same expression as the original CPU version.
   106	    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(x * kSqrtOneHalf));
   107	}
   108	
   109	__device__ __forceinline__ double blackScholesDevice(const OptionParameters& base,
   110	                                                     const double factor) {
   111	    const double spot = base.spot * factor;
   112	    const double strike = base.strike * factor;
   113	    const double rootT = sqrt(base.t);
   114	    const double sigmaRootT = base.vol * rootT;
   115	
   116	    const double d1 =
   117	        (log(spot / strike) +
   118	         (base.r - base.q + 0.5 * base.vol * base.vol) * base.t) /
   119	        sigmaRootT;
   120	    const double d2 = d1 - sigmaRootT;
   121	    const double discountR = exp(-base.r * base.t);
   122	    const double discountQ = exp(-base.q * base.t);
   123	
   124	    if (base.type == CALL) {
   125	        return spot * discountQ * cumulativeNormalDevice(d1) -
   126	               strike * discountR * cumulativeNormalDevice(d2);
   127	    }
   128	    return strike * discountR * cumulativeNormalDevice(-d2) -
   129	           spot * discountQ * cumulativeNormalDevice(-d1);
   130	}
   131	
   132	__global__ void blackScholesKernel(const unsigned long long globalOffset,
   133	                                   const std::size_t optionCount,
   134	                                   double* __restrict__ results) {
   135	    const std::size_t first =
   136	        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   137	    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
   138	
   139	    for (std::size_t localIndex = first; localIndex < optionCount;
   140	         localIndex += stride) {
   141	        const unsigned long long globalIndex =
   142	            globalOffset + static_cast<unsigned long long>(localIndex);
   143	        const int baseIndex = static_cast<int>(globalIndex % 7ULL);
   144	        const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (static_cast<double>(globalIndex) / 7.0);
   145	        results[localIndex] =
   146	            blackScholesDevice(kDeviceTestOptions[baseIndex], factor);
   147	    }
   148	}
   149	
   150	OptionInput generateOption(const std::size_t globalIndex) noexcept {
   151	    OptionInput option = kTestOptions[globalIndex % kTestOptions.size()];
   152	    const double factor =
   153	        1.0 + 0.1 * (globalIndex / static_cast<double>(kTestOptions.size()));
   154	    option.spot *= factor;
   155	    option.strike *= factor;
   156	    return option;
   157	}

   161	    std::array<OptionInput, 10> options{};

   164	    // independent of the device constants so it also checks data generation.
   165	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (checks > 1)

   177	
   178	        std::printf(

   180	            computed, expected, relativeError);

   182	            std::printf("Validation failed at option %d: invalid value %.4f\n", i,
   183	                        computed);
   184	            allPassed = false;
   185	        }
   186	    }
   187	    return allPassed;

   189	
   190	void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
   191	                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
   192	                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
   193	    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
   194	    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
   195	    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
   196	    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
   197	    std::vector<int> displacements;
   198	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   199	        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
   200	        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
   201	    }
   202	
   203	    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
   204	        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
   205	        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
   206	        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
   207	        const std::size_t localEnd =
   208	            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
   209	        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
   210	        const double* sendBuffer =
   211	            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
   212	                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
   213	
   214	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   215	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
   216	            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
   217	                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
   218	                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
   219	                const std::size_t end =
   220	                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
   221	                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
   222	                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
   223	                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
   224	                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
   225	            }
   226	        }
   227	
   228	        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
   229	                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
   230	                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
   231	                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
   232	                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   233	        windowBegin = windowEnd;
   234	    }
   235	}

   237	bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
   238	    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
   239	        return false;
   240	    }
   241	    errno = 0;
   242	    char* end = nullptr;
   243	    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
   244	    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
   245	        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
   246	        return false;
   247	    }
   248	    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
   249	    return true;
   250	}

   263	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   264	    int providedThreadLevel = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   265	    if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &providedThreadLevel) !=
   266	        MPI_SUCCESS) {
   267	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Unable to initialize MPI\n");
   268	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   269	    }
   270	
   271	    int worldRank = 0;
   272	    int worldSize = 1;
   273	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);
   274	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);
   275	    if (providedThreadLevel < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   276	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   277	            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide the required FUNNELED thread level\n");
   278	        }
   279	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   280	    }
   281	
   282	    std::size_t numberOfOptions = 10000;
   283	    bool validate = false;
   284	    bool printResults = false;
   285	    bool showHelp = false;
   286	    bool argumentsValid = true;
   287	
   288	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   289	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   290	            if (!parseOptionCount(argv[++i], numberOfOptions)) {
   291	                argumentsValid = false;
   292	            }
   293	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   294	            validate = true;
   295	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   296	            printResults = true;
   297	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   298	            showHelp = true;
   299	        } else {
   300	            if (worldRank == 0) {
   301	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   302	            }
   303	            argumentsValid = false;
   304	        }
   305	    }
   306	    if (numberOfOptions >
   307	        std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
   308	        argumentsValid = false;
   309	    }
   310	
   311	    if (showHelp || !argumentsValid) {
   312	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   313	            if (!argumentsValid) {
   314	                std::printf("Invalid command-line arguments\n");
   315	            }
   316	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   317	        }
   318	        MPI_Finalize();
   319	        return argumentsValid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   320	    }
   321	
   322	    MPI_Comm nodeCommunicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   323	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, worldRank,
   324	                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeCommunicator);
   325	    int nodeRank = 0;
   326	    int ranksOnNode = 1;
   327	    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeCommunicator, &nodeRank);
   328	    MPI_Comm_size(nodeCommunicator, &ranksOnNode);
   329	
   330	    int deviceCount = 0;
   331	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   332	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
   333	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   334	            std::fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA-capable device is visible\n");
   335	        }
   336	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   337	    }
   338	    const int device = nodeRank % deviceCount;
   339	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   340	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDeviceFlags(cudaDeviceScheduleSpin));
   341	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr)); // Create the CUDA context before timing.
   342	
   343	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   344	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   345	
   346	    const Range localRange = partitionRange(numberOfOptions, worldSize, worldRank);
   347	    const bool needGlobalResults = validate || printResults;
   348	
   349	    double* deviceResults = nullptr;
   350	    double* localResults = nullptr;
   351	    if (localRange.count != 0) {
   352	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceResults),
   353	                              localRange.count * sizeof(double)));
   354	        if (needGlobalResults) {
   355	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&localResults),
   356	                                      localRange.count * sizeof(double)));
   357	        }
   358	    }
   359	
   360	    const std::size_t localBlocks =
   361	        (localRange.count + static_cast<std::size_t>(kCudaBlockSize) - 1) /
   362	        static_cast<std::size_t>(kCudaBlockSize);
   363	    const int streamCount = localBlocks == 0
   364	                                ? 0
   365	                                : static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
   366	                                      localBlocks,
   367	                                      static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(
   368	                                          1, std::min(kMaximumStreamsPerRank,
   369	                                                      omp_get_max_threads())))));
   370	    std::vector<cudaStream_t> streams(static_cast<std::size_t>(streamCount));
   371	    for (int stream = 0; stream < streamCount; ++stream) {
   372	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(
   373	            &streams[static_cast<std::size_t>(stream)], cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   374	    }
   375	
   376	    // Force CUDA module loading/JIT initialization out of the timed region. The
   377	    // timed launch overwrites this element, so warm-up cannot affect the result.
   378	    if (localRange.count != 0) {
   379	        blackScholesKernel<<<1, 1, 0, streams[0]>>>(
   380	            static_cast<unsigned long long>(localRange.offset), 1, deviceResults);
   381	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   382	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams[0]));
   383	    }
   384	
   385	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   386	        std::printf("Black-Scholes Option Pricing Benchmark\n");
   387	        std::printf("Number of options: %zu\n", numberOfOptions);
   388	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   389	        std::printf("Parallel configuration: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP "
   390	                    "thread(s)/rank, CUDA GPUs\n",
   391	                    worldSize, omp_get_max_threads());
   392	        if (ranksOnNode > deviceCount) {
   393	            std::printf("Note: %d local MPI ranks share %d visible CUDA device(s)\n",
   394	                        ranksOnNode, deviceCount);
   395	        }
   396	        std::printf("Pricing options...\n");
   397	    }
   398	
   399	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   400	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   401	
   402	    // OpenMP host threads concurrently feed nonblocking CUDA streams. Each stream
   403	    // owns a contiguous output range, so no synchronization or atomics are needed.
   404	    std::vector<cudaError_t> streamErrors(static_cast<std::size_t>(streamCount),
   405	                                          cudaSuccess);
   406	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(std::max(1, streamCount)) if (streamCount > 1)
   407	    for (int streamIndex = 0; streamIndex < streamCount; ++streamIndex) {
   408	        cudaError_t error = cudaSetDevice(device);
   409	        const Range streamRange =
   410	            partitionRange(localRange.count, streamCount, streamIndex);
   411	        cudaStream_t stream = streams[static_cast<std::size_t>(streamIndex)];
   412	
   413	        if (error == cudaSuccess && streamRange.count != 0) {
   414	            const std::size_t requiredBlocks =
   415	                (streamRange.count + static_cast<std::size_t>(kCudaBlockSize) - 1) /
   416	                static_cast<std::size_t>(kCudaBlockSize);
   417	            const std::size_t occupancyBlocks = static_cast<std::size_t>(
   418	                std::max(1, deviceProperties.multiProcessorCount * 16 / streamCount));
   419	            const unsigned int gridSize = static_cast<unsigned int>(
   420	                std::min(requiredBlocks, occupancyBlocks));
   421	
   422	            blackScholesKernel<<<gridSize, kCudaBlockSize, 0, stream>>>(
   423	                static_cast<unsigned long long>(localRange.offset + streamRange.offset),
   424	                streamRange.count, deviceResults + streamRange.offset);
   425	            error = cudaGetLastError();
   426	        }
   427	        if (error == cudaSuccess && streamRange.count != 0 && needGlobalResults) {
   428	            error = cudaMemcpyAsync(localResults + streamRange.offset,
   429	                                    deviceResults + streamRange.offset,
   430	                                    streamRange.count * sizeof(double),
   431	                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream);
   432	        }
   433	        if (error == cudaSuccess) {
   434	            error = cudaStreamSynchronize(stream);
   435	        }
   436	        streamErrors[static_cast<std::size_t>(streamIndex)] = error;
   437	    }
   438	
   439	    for (int stream = 0; stream < streamCount; ++stream) {
   440	        const cudaError_t error = streamErrors[static_cast<std::size_t>(stream)];
   441	        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
   442	            abortCuda(error, "hybrid CUDA stream execution", worldRank);
   443	        }
   444	    }
   445	
   446	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   447	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   448	    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   449	
   450	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   451	        const double milliseconds = elapsed * 1000.0;
   452	        const double rate = elapsed > 0.0
   453	                                ? static_cast<double>(numberOfOptions) / elapsed
   454	                                : std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
   455	        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", milliseconds);
   456	        std::printf("Options per second: %.0f\n", rate);
   457	    }
   458	
   459	    std::vector<double> globalResults;
   460	    if (needGlobalResults) {
   461	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   462	            globalResults.resize(numberOfOptions);
   463	        }
   464	        gatherResults(localResults, localRange, numberOfOptions, worldSize, worldRank,
   465	                      globalResults);
   466	    }
   467	
   468	    int returnCode = EXIT_SUCCESS;
   469	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   470	        if (printResults) {
   471	            print_results(globalResults, "OptionPrices");
   472	        }
   473	        if (validate) {
   474	            std::printf("Validating results...\n");
   475	            const bool valid = validateResults(globalResults);
   476	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   477	            returnCode = valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   478	        }
   479	    }
   480	    MPI_Bcast(&returnCode, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   481	
   482	    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams) {
   483	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
   484	    }
   485	    if (localResults != nullptr) {
   486	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(localResults));
   487	    }
   488	    if (deviceResults != nullptr) {
   489	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceResults));
   490	    }
   491	    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeCommunicator);
   492	    MPI_Finalize();
   493	    return returnCode;
   494	}

+__global__ void blackScholesKernel(const unsigned long long globalOffset,
+                                   const std::size_t optionCount,
+                                   double* __restrict__ results) {
+    const std::size_t first =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+
+    for (std::size_t localIndex = first; localIndex < optionCount;
+         localIndex += stride) {
+        const unsigned long long globalIndex =
+            globalOffset + static_cast<unsigned long long>(localIndex);
+        const int baseIndex = static_cast<int>(globalIndex % 7ULL);

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+struct Range {
+    std::size_t offset;
+    std::size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
+    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
+                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
+    return {offset, quotient + extra};
 }

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        const double milliseconds = elapsed * 1000.0;
+        const double rate = elapsed > 0.0
+                                ? static_cast<double>(numberOfOptions) / elapsed
+                                : std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
+        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", milliseconds);
+        std::printf("Options per second: %.0f\n", rate);
+    }
+
+    std::vector<double> globalResults;
+    if (needGlobalResults) {
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+            globalResults.resize(numberOfOptions);
+        }
+        gatherResults(localResults, localRange, numberOfOptions, worldSize, worldRank,
+                      globalResults);
+    }
+
+    int returnCode = EXIT_SUCCESS;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        if (printResults) {
+            print_results(globalResults, "OptionPrices");
         }
+        if (validate) {
+            std::printf("Validating results...\n");
+            const bool valid = validateResults(globalResults);
+            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
+            returnCode = valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
+        }
+    }
+    MPI_Bcast(&returnCode, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    }
+    if (localResults != nullptr) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(localResults));
     }
-    
-    return 0;
+    if (deviceResults != nullptr) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceResults));
+    }
+    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeCommunicator);
+    MPI_Finalize();
+    return returnCode;
 }

+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
+    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
+                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
+    return {offset, quotient + extra};

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

codex
The final audit caught and fixed an edge case in the large-result gather: zero-count ranks beyond a gather window now use displacement zero, so very large distributed outputs cannot overflow an ignored MPI displacement. I also removed a misleading GPU-sharing notice for schedulers that give each rank a separately renumbered `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` namespace.

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+struct Range {
+    std::size_t offset;
+    std::size_t count;
+};
+
+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
+    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
+                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
+    return {offset, quotient + extra};
 }

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}
+
+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");

+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t extra = partition < static_cast<int>(remainder) ? 1U : 0U;
+    const std::size_t offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(partition) * quotient +
+                               std::min(static_cast<std::size_t>(partition), remainder);
+    return {offset, quotient + extra};

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

codex
Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA benchmark while preserving the `black_scholes` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI-balanced global option partitioning and node-local GPU assignment.
- OpenMP threads concurrently drive up to eight asynchronous CUDA streams.
- CUDA grid-stride Black-Scholes kernel with constant-memory parameters.
- GPU-side deterministic option generation eliminates input scatter and host-to-device transfers.
- Ordered, windowed MPI result gathering supports counts beyond `INT_MAX`.
- Native GPU architecture and `-O3` build optimization.
- Only existing files changed:
  - [black_scholes.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/black-scholes_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r3/black-scholes/black_scholes.cpp:131)
  - [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/black-scholes_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r3/black-scholes/CMakeLists.txt:1)

Validation completed successfully for single- and four-rank runs, including zero-sized and uneven partitions. CPU/GPU displayed values match, with only expected last-bit libm rounding differences.

Observed on the available RTX 3090 node for 10 million options:

- One GPU: approximately 728 million options/s
- Four MPI ranks/GPUs: approximately 1.49 billion options/s

+struct Range {

+Range partitionRange(const std::size_t total, const int partitions,
+                     const int partition) noexcept {
+    const std::size_t quotient = total / static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);
+    const std::size_t remainder = total % static_cast<std::size_t>(partitions);

+void gatherResults(const double* localResults, const Range localRange,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int worldSize,
+                   const int worldRank, std::vector<double>& globalResults) {
+    // MPI-3 count and displacement arguments are int. Windowed Gatherv retains
+    // collective scalability while also supporting arrays larger than INT_MAX.
+    constexpr std::size_t kGatherWindow = 1ULL << 30;
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    if (worldRank == 0) {
+        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+        displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(worldSize));
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t windowBegin = 0; windowBegin < total;) {
+        const std::size_t windowSize = std::min(kGatherWindow, total - windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t windowEnd = windowBegin + windowSize;
+        const std::size_t localBegin = std::max(localRange.offset, windowBegin);
+        const std::size_t localEnd =
+            std::min(localRange.offset + localRange.count, windowEnd);
+        const std::size_t sendSize = localEnd > localBegin ? localEnd - localBegin : 0;
+        const double* sendBuffer =
+            sendSize == 0 ? localResults
+                          : localResults + (localBegin - localRange.offset);
+
+        if (worldRank == 0) {
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (worldSize > 1)
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+                const Range rankRange = partitionRange(total, worldSize, rank);
+                const std::size_t begin = std::max(rankRange.offset, windowBegin);
+                const std::size_t end =
+                    std::min(rankRange.offset + rankRange.count, windowEnd);
+                const std::size_t count = end > begin ? end - begin : 0;
+                receiveCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] =
+                    count == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<int>(begin - windowBegin);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Gatherv(sendBuffer, static_cast<int>(sendSize), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? globalResults.data() + windowBegin : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
+                    worldRank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        windowBegin = windowEnd;
+    }
+}

+bool parseOptionCount(const char* text, std::size_t& value) noexcept {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA benchmark while preserving the `black_scholes` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI-balanced global option partitioning and node-local GPU assignment.
- OpenMP threads concurrently drive up to eight asynchronous CUDA streams.
- CUDA grid-stride Black-Scholes kernel with constant-memory parameters.
- GPU-side deterministic option generation eliminates input scatter and host-to-device transfers.
- Ordered, windowed MPI result gathering supports counts beyond `INT_MAX`.
- Native GPU architecture and `-O3` build optimization.
